text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...How odd. I was certain I heard someone 
calling out."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was certain it was someone from the 
dorms, but... It looks like no one's here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The statue of the Three Goddesses, huh.
